payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustively checks all possible equal-sum partitions of 4 bags using hardcoded condition checks (1 vs 3 and 2 vs 2).
payload.rationale: Solution brute-forces the small search space of 2^4 assignments by manually enumerating the two possible splits: one bag equals sum of others, or two pairs equal. This is essentially bitmask enumeration without loops.
